description:
## [1.5.9](https://github.com/YYDarlinker/morphe-ai-caption-translator/compare/v1.5.8...v1.5.9) (2026-10-30)

- Reduce missing translated text when a passage spans several source subtitle lines.
- Preserve the timing of adjacent translated passages when they are displayed together.
- Improve page breaks around sentence continuations and introductory words, and avoid splitting words across overflow pages.
- Fix clipped opening captions when entering fullscreen.

patches.name: AI caption translator
patches.description: Translates the selected YouTube Auto-translate language in real time through your OpenAI-compatible API.

release_notes:
- Improve caption state when switching videos or turning AI off, keeping late translations out of the current captions.
- Respect service retry delays and reduce unnecessary requests from old translation tasks.
- Keep unsaved input after settings errors and apply fields that were successfully saved.
- Show clearer errors for unreadable settings without deleting credentials; allow retrying synchronization after a successful save.
- Preserve valid source captions when a cache update fails.
- Make diagnostics clearer about service errors, retry waits and why translation stopped.
repoDescription: Real-time YouTube subtitle translation using your own OpenAI-compatible API. Independent patch bundle compatible with Morphe.
